items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) on ETR Sunday injury report for Week 3 vs IND. Confirmed by team/Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Elevates Dalton Schultz target share (28% last week without him) and other HOU pass-catchers
items.opportunity: Schultz high routes/targets; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe) Week 3 vs CIN per ETR list. Steelers coach: Jaylen Warren will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury, no practice, ruled out
items.implication: Warren clear lead back; Homer/Heidenreich backups
items.opportunity: Warren lead + checkdowns vs CIN; vertical pass game struggling for Rodgers

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (left elbow) for Week 3 vs SEA. Not IR; positive longer-term notes from Rapoport. Mariota starts.
items.why: Ruled out Friday; same elbow as prior year
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin still viable but tougher SEA matchup and low team total

items.text: Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL (hip/groin) Week 3 vs DEN; McVay expects return next week vs PHI barring setback. Adams can carry load.
items.implication: Likely inactive; more volume to Davante Adams
items.opportunity: Adams primary; Surtain matchup considerations for others

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey IN/ACTIVE (off injury report) Week 3 vs LAR; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.why: Full/good to go Friday; Coleman out
items.implication: Committee continues; reverse any Coleman-only beneficiaries

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection of 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim ceiling highest ever in their model

items.text: With Dowdle OUT, Jaylen Warren is the clear lead back; coach says he leads and gets breathers. Expect checkdown spam as vertical game failing for Rodgers; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.why: Coach quote + usage vacuum; vertical inefficiency
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with volume upside vs CIN
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; high snap share expected

items.text: First game without Jayden Reed: Christian Watson 45 routes, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson+Golden 48% of Love targets season-to-date.
items.opportunity: High route % and target share continuation

items.text: Jonathon Brooks on IR (core surgery, 6-8 weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead/workhorse with AJ Dillon backup. Hubbard RB14 util already.
LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
LOVE Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share last week sans Collins; IND allows 4th-most TE yards.
Kyle Pitts only 63% route participation, 6 targets/8% share through games. TPRR 33% without London on field vs 17% with him; long-time fade continues.

LOVE Chris Olave (vs LV: double-digit tgts, 53% air yards, LV allows 18.7 YPR); Christian Watson (vs ATL: WR8 util, 38% RZ share); Chase Brown (@PIT: 20+ touches, 15% share both games, PIT soft vs RBs).
HATE Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: low snaps/touches post-fumble, tough run D); Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps); Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest FPs to WRs, low team total).
items.conflict: Henderson snaps rising but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead
